pipeline.heading: From seed to image
pipeline.description: How the code below turns an NFT’s seed into its artwork, step by step.
pipeline.galleryLink: See the images in the gallery

seed.label: Seed
seed.description: The NFT’s seed, recorded on-chain when it is imprinted.

stream.label: SHA3-256 random stream
stream.description: Hashes the seed into a reproducible stream of random bytes.

simulation.label: Three-body simulation
simulation.description: Takes three bodies’ masses, positions and velocities from the stream and computes their orbits.

renderer.label: Spectral renderer
renderer.description: Traces each body’s path in a color that drifts across the spectrum.

image.label: Cosmic Signature NFT image
image.description: The last frame is the image and the frames together the video. The same seed always gives the same result.

frontend.description: The Next.js website and application interface.

backend.description: Indexes on-chain events and serves protocol data through an API.
